questions.subject: Physics
questions.topic: System of Particles and Rotational Motion
questions.question: A solid sphere and a hollow sphere of the same mass and radius are released together from the top of an inclined plane and roll down without slipping. Which reaches the bottom first?
options: It depends only on the mass
questions.explanation: Acceleration while rolling is a = g sinθ/(1 + k²/R²). The solid sphere has the smaller value of k²/R² (2/5 against 2/3), so it accelerates more and arrives first.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 6: System of Particles and Rotational Motion

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: In a stationary wave, the distance between two consecutive nodes is:
questions.explanation: Nodes repeat every half wavelength, and the gap between a node and the next antinode is λ/4.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Three capacitors, each of capacitance 3 μF, are joined in series. The equivalent capacitance of the combination is:
questions.explanation: In series 1/C = 1/3 + 1/3 + 1/3 = 1, giving C = 1 μF, which is smaller than any individual capacitor.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 12, Chapter 2: Electrostatic Potential and Capacitance

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: In the reaction 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O, when 2 mol of hydrogen reacts completely with 1 mol of oxygen, the mass of water formed is:
questions.explanation: The equation gives 2 mol of water from 2 mol of hydrogen, and 2 × 18 = 36 g. Note that 4 g of H₂ plus 32 g of O₂ also totals 36 g, as mass is conserved.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 1: Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: On dilution, the conductivity of an electrolytic solution decreases while its molar conductivity increases. The decrease in conductivity happens because:
options: The number of ions per unit volume decreases
questions.explanation: Conductivity is measured per unit volume, and dilution spreads the same ions over more volume. Molar conductivity rises because the total number of ions per mole goes up with dissociation.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The secondary structure of a protein, such as the alpha helix, is stabilised mainly by:
questions.explanation: Hydrogen bonds between the C=O of one peptide unit and the N-H of another hold the helix or sheet in shape. Peptide bonds define the primary structure instead.

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: During DNA replication, short Okazaki fragments are synthesised on the:
questions.explanation: DNA polymerase works only in the 5' to 3' direction, so the strand with the opposite polarity is copied in short pieces that DNA ligase later joins.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 5: Molecular Basis of Inheritance

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: The ten per cent law of energy transfer between successive trophic levels was proposed by:
questions.explanation: Lindeman stated that only about 10 percent of the energy at one trophic level passes to the next, which is why food chains rarely have more than four or five links.

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: The counter current mechanism that helps the kidney produce concentrated urine is maintained by the:
options: Loop of Henle and vasa recta
questions.explanation: The loop of Henle and the parallel blood vessels of the vasa recta set up an increasing osmolarity towards the medulla, which lets water be withdrawn from the collecting duct.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 16: Excretory Products and their Elimination

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: In humans, implantation of the blastocyst normally takes place in the:
questions.explanation: The blastocyst embeds in the thickened endometrium about a week after fertilisation. Implantation anywhere else is an ectopic pregnancy.
